content: No-build JS/HTML syntax checking in CI: node --check parses without executing but module detection follows execution rules — .js files with import/export need 'type':'module' in package.json (or .mjs extension) or --check fails with 'Cannot use import statement outside a module'. Loop: git ls-files '*.js' | xargs -n1 node --check (-n1 because node checks only first file arg). --check validates syntax only, not import-specifier resolution. HTMLHint lints HTML (tag-pair, doctype-first, id-unique, src-not-empty) with non-zero exit for CI; html-validate or vnu-jar for spec validation instead of linting.
